head: dff6a12c65ec5062cbb2a477b28da3391e24ca56
summary: Eve reconciliation has two runtime contract gaps: downstream note-write failures are mislabeled as session-stream read failures, and candidate output writeback is not atomic.

findings.detail: runOnce marks every reconcileRun exception as session_stream_read_failed, including transient recordMeetingNoteGeneration failures after a successful stream read. This creates false stream-failure and recovery audit history.
recordMeetingCandidates updates task, decision, and follow-up outputs sequentially. A mid-write failure leaves a partially updated candidate set and no reliable atomic boundary.
